title: Microsoft ditches Copilot's mascot Mico (and cuts a few AI features)
excerpt: Copilot's consumer and business apps are merging, resulting in these changes.
content_html:
Say "goodbye" to Mico and a handful of AI tools, Microsoft Copilot users.

According to new Microsoft support documents, the tech giant is making major changes to its AI assistant, Copilot.

The biggest change to Copilot is that it will no longer exist as separate apps for consumer and business use. Microsoft will merge both the consumer Copilot app and the business-oriented Microsoft 365 Copilot app into a single application.

You May Also Like

During this process, Microsoft is also killing off some lesser-used features, including Mico, its animated Clippy-like Copilot mascot. Mico is a blob-like animated character who currently lives in Copilot as an AI companion. 

According to Microsoft, Mico will be removed as part of a wave of Copilot updates rolling out to users throughout August. While Microsoft is killing Mico off in Copilot, the company says Mico will have a new home on a much less-used Microsoft platform, Learn Live, where the character will work as a tutor for users.

Mashable Light Speed

But Mico isn't the only Copilot element that Microsoft is ditching.

Microsoft is also removing Copilot's Group Chat, Podcasts, Deep Research, and experimental Copilot Labs features.

Group Chats are a Copilot feature that allows multiple users to collaborate in a single Copilot AI chat. The Podcast feature enabled users to create AI-generated podcasts based on web interests and documents. Deep Research is a feature Microsoft dubbed a personal research assistant for creating detailed reports. Copilot Labs provided Copilot users with access to early-stage features.

According to Microsoft, these four AI features will sunset on Aug. 18. All related generated content will also be removed. So, if a user has group chats or podcasts that they'd like to save, they need to export the content by that date.

Microsoft says it's making these changes to Copilot to "create a simpler, more cohesive experience for everyone."

However, a report from The Information late last year revealed more pressing problems with Microsoft's suite of AI tools. The company had significantly reduced AI-related sales targets as Copilot increasingly lost market share to AI tools from companies such as OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic.

content_html_zh:
向 Mico 和少数 AI 工具、Microsoft Copilot 用户说“再见”。

根据微软新的支持文件，这家科技巨头正在对其人工智能助手 Copilot 进行重大改变。

Copilot 最大的变化是，它将不再作为单独的应用程序供消费者和企业使用。 Microsoft 将把消费者 Copilot 应用程序和面向业务的 Microsoft 365 Copilot 应用程序合并为一个应用程序。

你可能也喜欢

在此过程中，微软还取消了一些较少使用的功能，包括 Mico，其类似 Clippy 的动画 Copilot 吉祥物。 Mico 是一个像斑点一样的动画角色，目前作为 AI 伴侣生活在 Copilot 中。

据微软称，Mico 将作为整个 8 月份向用户推出的 Copilot 更新浪潮的一部分被删除。 虽然微软正在淘汰《Copilot》中的 Mico，但该公司表示，Mico 将在一个较少使用的微软平台 Learn Live 上拥有一个新家，该角色将在其中担任用户的导师。

可混搭光速

但 Mico 并不是微软唯一放弃的 Copilot 元素。

微软还删除了 Copilot 的群聊、播客、深度研究和实验性 Copilot Labs 功能。

群组聊天是 Copilot 的一项功能，允许多个用户在单个 Copilot AI 聊天中进行协作。 播客功能使用户能够根据网络兴趣和文档创建人工智能生成的播客。 深度研究是微软称为个人研究助理的一项功能，用于创建详细报告。 Copilot Labs 为 Copilot 用户提供了早期功能的访问权限。

据微软称，这四项 AI 功能将于 8 月 18 日停用。 所有相关生成的内容也将被删除。 因此，如果用户想要保存群聊或播客，他们需要在该日期之前导出内容。

微软表示，它对 Copilot 进行这些更改是为了“为每个人创造更简单、更有凝聚力的体验”。

然而，《The Information》去年年底的一份报告揭示了微软人工智能工具套件面临的更紧迫的问题。 随着 Copilot 的市场份额不断被 OpenAI、谷歌和 Anthropic 等公司的人工智能工具夺走，该公司大幅降低了与人工智能相关的销售目标。
